*The current energy recovery has been changed from hourly to continuous recovery every second.

-Reduce divine power decay:
*Changed from 1% to 0.1%.

-Added defense distance tips for remote buildings:

-Increase the firing volume of the musket tower:
* Increased from 25 to 30.

-Automatic attack prompt optimization:
* Added a reminder about when the automatic attack will start.

-Remove the slower frame rate program:
*Removed the program related to frame correction to avoid the problem.

-The offense was changed to a 2-day cycle:
*Independently added a new date loop,
Now the offense has more suitable days.

-Timely reminder of attack days:
*Now the attack time and the number of days and hours waiting for the attack will be updated in time.

-Merchants, teachers, priests, and chefs will also be stationed:
*Now all kinds of towns and villagers will stay within their service range.

-Town villagers no longer collide repeatedly:
*Fixed a waste of efficiency caused by repeated collisions.

Various idle military units will actively conduct territorial defense.

-Enemy assembly:
*Now the enemy will gather in strongholds in peacetime,

-Fixed an issue where enemy villagers get stuck when summoning:
*Fixed a programming issue where the enemy villagers may not be able to move normally.

-Added automatic check of whether the building needs defense:
*Added the inspection function about automatic defense,
Now every hour the system will re-correct the order of automatic defense.

-Added the flag of building defense:
*Now when the building is occupied and is under defense,
An obvious defensive mark will appear on the map.

-Zoom in and out of defense marks:
*Now the defensive markers will be enlarged and reduced appropriately with the map.

-Stop offense button:
* Added a new command to stop the attack,
Usually used to stop defending buildings that are too far away.

-Offensive flags will also assist defensive buildings:
*Now when auto attack is on,
The automatically placed flag will also consider whether there is a building under defense,
And prioritize the assembly of soldiers for defense.

2021/2/18 # 152

*Now when the building is occupied,

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206008/3a2137d6fc7a28435414a9160e92ba5bde8cb7fc.jpg

【MiniMap Kingdom】Update # 112~130

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206008/be8350a78b78e3a204960fce280499ad1341a7e4.jpg

Major update:

-Map altitude parameters:
* Added an altitude parameter for the map generator,
Make the map more natural.

-Remake map system:
*Completed various old versions of the code,
Completed the new map generator,
Now there will be more obvious oceans, land and various terrains,
And it reduces the scattered terrain.

-Resource consumption statistics:
*The resource report now shows the number of all units and buildings.

-The target distance will be considered when the unit is called:
*Now when the king summons villagers or troops,
The summoned unit will maintain the alignment according to the summoning distance,
Corrected the situation of repeated walking when calling.

-All units and buildings use the same HP status Prefabs:
*Refactored all the units and buildings,
Now they will call the same pre-made object to reduce performance consumption,
And easier to modify and adjust.

-Remove a lot of useless Canvas and automatically close:
* Deleted useless UI rendering that took up a lot of performance,
And when the canvas is outside the lens,
The canvas system will automatically shut down to save performance.

-Upgrade the game to 64-bit:
*Improved the performance of the game and updated the store page.

-The waterman gets water acceleration:
*Now the boats working in the water will have a faster independent speed on the water,
And a new unit reminder.

-Full translation of unit name:
* Completed the unit name, production unit, repelled the enemy,
System translation for tracking and attacking, etc.

-Doctors heal themselves every hour:
*Now doctors will be based on level and treatment skills,
Try to heal itself with a lower recovery amount every hour.

-Delayed stuttering frames:
* Added a stabilization system for the number of frames,
Now when the system starts Lag,
The game will automatically slow down to maintain stable performance,
Fixed the situation of frame skipping in the late game.

-Easy difficulty reduces knight invasion:
*Now the enemy's knights on Easy difficulty will not appear in the early stage.


Update details:

2020/11/24 # 112~114

*The map system has been reworked and restored to a situation where it can move freely.

* Removed useless hidden buttons, cameras and maps.

2020/11/26 # 116

*Reduce the redundant random judgment when the unit moves.

* Fixed the situation where various buildings consume the same amount of energy,

2020/11/27 # 117

* Reduced excessive damage and energy consumption.

* Increased the enemy's damage to the king.

*Fixed a description of no energy.

*Fixed a situation where teaching cannot be opened normally.

2020/11/27 # 118

*The unit status in the lens is now displayed correctly.

2020/11/28 # 119

* Increased shooting volume and reduced speed.

-Reduce bullet speed:
* Now the bullet has a more obvious trajectory.

-The building prompt section on the lower left does not repeat the prompt building:
*Fixed some meaningless long prompts.

-Map adjustment:
* Increased water, reduced the ratio of green land to mud land,
Reduced the hash of the opening map.

-Preset color optimization:
*It is now (1.0, 0.95, 0.9) white.

-The program changes back to the judgment per second:
*Fixed a situation where the unit determination is too slow.

*Now it will clearly indicate the amount of generated resources for each creation.

* Patrol judgement to reduce consumption efficiency.

2020/11/29 # 120

*Fixed an issue where the unit status faded out.

* Now when the enemy is summoned in place, they will also try to maintain the formation instead of repeating their movements.

-Re-optimize loop performance:
*Reduce the program logic of repeated judgment of faction and villagers summoning.

2020/11/29 # 121

-Fixed the delay problem:
*Fixed a delay problem that may slow down in the later stage.

-FixUpdate time synchronization delay:
* Now the time loop has an independent loop instead of occupying a physical loop.

-Summon the flag is no longer delayed:
*Fixed the delay of summoning the flag.

2020/11/29 # 122

-Increase the amount of base divine power recovery:
*From 100 to 250.

-Adjust timescale and realtime:
*A system adjustment was made,
Make the system time more accurate to reduce performance consumption.

2020/11/29 # 123

-Fixed time issue:
*Fixed a serious delay problem.

2020/11/30 # 124

-Optimization of map copy system:
*Optimized the underlying architecture of a map generator.

2020/11/30 # 125

-The plumber only consumes water when fetching water:
*Fixed a situation where water sources would be consumed when fishing for fish.

-Water consumption balance:
* Reduced excessive farm water consumption.

-The unit status fades more clearly and smoothly:
*The current unit status will fade in and out more clearly.

-Lens optimization:
*Fixed the picture jitter that may be caused by some delays.

2020/12/1 # 126

*Optimized the underlying architecture of a map generator.

-Unit mobile program optimization:
* Reduced the movement delay of units and deleted useless programs.

-Adjust unit speed:
*The speed of various units has been reset.

2020/12/1 # 127

*Now the system will reduce the movement judgment when needed,

* Increased the proportion of ocean and other land.

*Now the time loop program is more independent,

*Fixed an English error and removed unnecessary programs.

*Now there is a more suitable font size.

-Villagers and units by boat:

-Musketeer sound effect restoration:
*Fixed the problem of only playing one sound.

-Sound effects only play when approaching:
*Fixed a problem of sound effects playing too far away.

*Fixed a situation where villagers would only go to the end of the road.

-New map:
* Added map and minimap functions.

-Minimap flag:
*The flag will now scale with the size of the minimap.

-Adjust unit size:
*Make the unit easier to identify.

-Map button:

*Now no longer wasting performance on repeated terrain determination programs.

-Set button ESC:

-Map button M:

-Timber road and park description changed to happiness:

-setactive optimization:
*Now the program will no longer switch ship objects meaninglessly.

*Now the water workers can also fish for fish to produce food,
Added unit reminder and food report reminder.

*Now you can use the map to zoom the camera.

-Exclusive flag on the minimap:
*The minimap is now separate from the flag of the main camera,

-Adjust the pre-stage, post-stage, and attack power:
*Now the king has a basic divine power recovery value,
And the divine power will no longer accumulate indefinitely,

-Lens size and speed, zoom optimization when opening the map:
*Now the speed of moving the map will be related to the size of the map view.

2020/11/13 # 106

-Minimap optimization:
*Slightly adjusted the position and preset size.

-Fishing adjustment:
*The chance is changed to 20%, 5 units of food each time.


2020/11/14 # 107

-Do not use shortcut keys when the main menu is open:
*Fixed the problem that the field may be opened when entering the name.

-Click to shoot:
*Now you can freely decide where to attack.

-Added game over description:
* Added when the game ends,
Tips on the conditions of failure and the ending of the map.

-Quick building button:
* Added a small UI that can directly build various buildings.

-Tips for building and unit name description:
*Now the floating prompt window will also prompt the name of the unit corresponding to the building.


2020/11/15 # 108

-Teaching is not forced to open:
*Now the outdated teaching will no longer jump out when starting the game.

-Remove the summon function:
*The summon function for testing has been removed.

-The initial summoning is changed to 1 grid:
*Now you can summon units to within 1 block,
Reduce the situation where players mistakenly think that the unit cannot be summoned.

-Shortcut key B changed to quick construction:
*Now you can switch the quick construction field when you press B.

-Difficulty prompt location and content optimization:
*The small tip in the lower left corner is now more streamlined.

-Initial town infrastructure and villagers:
*Now some villagers and buildings will start the game.

-Fixed pause can shoot:
*Fixed an issue where the king can attack the enemy while paused.

-King attack unlimited distance:
*Now you can use divine power to attack very far enemies.

-Arrow and bullet program optimization, automatic destruction and correction:
* Now the bullet will be destroyed correctly,
And it reduces efficiency consumption and errors.

notes.title: 【MiniMap Kingdom】Update # 6 : 敵人城鎮、狗屋、集結旗幟、工人經濟、優化重製和其他內容。
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206008/9732fbb98264d3454356ef5381b31f095b298bef.jpg

【MiniMap Kingdom】Update # 6

上架的第一週沒有睡覺的更新了20個版本，
測試到好累了，絕望的感覺不停地蔓延著。
(つд⊂)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206008/999f8d3acd6e75046a2733eb181df7ddfad92bb0.jpg

細節:

-新增狗:
*新增了快速移動的狗和狗屋。

-敵人城鎮:
*新增了大型莊園、中型城鎮、小型村莊、哨站和哨塔等敵人建設。

-集結旗幟:
*新增了一個可以自由放在地圖任一角落的集結旗幟，
現在不用移動國王也可以發動遠征了。

-鏡頭Follow開關:
*現在玩家可以自由的決定鏡頭是否要跟隨角色，
這在進行遠端戰略時很有幫助。

-單位補給系統:
*現在工作單位會回到城鎮補給資源，
並且工人們會以城鎮為中心向外採集。

-城鎮單位針對居民工作:
*現在城鎮單位會尋找城內的村民來工作，
譬如教士傳教、老師教書、商人兜售等等。

-敵人經濟設施:
*新增了包含農場、水庫、林地、礦場等敵人的經濟設施。

-修正敵人生成位置過近:
*修正了一個可能導致敵人直接生在玩家附近的問題。

-地圖邊界實際邊界外:
*現在敵人會更傾向於將建築設置在未探索的區域中了。

-相機移動:
*現在使用滾輪拉近時會往滑鼠的位置直觀的縮放了，
並且修正了滑鼠滾輪的預設方向。

-新增資訊細節按鈕:
*現在可以在左上方查看敵人的資源和進攻人數了。

-移除失敗結束按鈕:
*刪除了測試用的失敗時逃出遊戲按鈕。

-降低按鈕音效、音樂等音效
*對各種音量進行了平衡。

-修正箭矢類讀檔留存場景問題:
*修復了一個場景中殘留箭矢或子彈可能會留到下個場景的問題。

-提高單位移動速度:
*明顯提高了譬如工人等單位極為緩慢的移動速度。

-缺少神力提示:
*現在會提示可以增加人口或教堂了。

-提高玩家基礎速度:
*現在讓國王在剛開場時也會有足夠的速度。

-修正主選單可以解鎖成就:
*修正了放置主選單或角色死亡後還可以解鎖Steam天數成就的問題。

-入侵單位不設限:
*現在不會再出現長時間沒有入侵軍團的情況了。

-單位攻擊中時不隨意移動:
*修正了單位攻擊中仍然漫遊的情況，
這解決了弓箭手或火槍兵不瞄準敵方單位的問題。

-修正劍士距離外不播放動畫:
*修正了各種單位距離過遠時不會有動作的情況。

-鏡頭縮放時修正建築變色問題:
*現在鏡頭倍率變化時會自動修正隱藏的陣營顏色問題。

-城鎮建築人口分散:
*給每個建築新增了各自的單位生產列表，
這讓後期攻佔敵人城鎮後人口會分散的出現在各個分城了。

-學城、學校建築率:
*新增了一種由學校包圍城堡的學城設施，
並提高了敵人對學校的建築需求。

-大型城鎮箭塔:
*現在大型莊園會額外獲得四座箭塔和八個建築點了。

-遊戲節奏調整:
*現在開場雙方都是從零開始了。

-國王走迷霧不耗能:
*現在國王走入迷霧不會再消耗大量能量了。

-旗幟放置不移動:
*修正了放置旗幟時會同時移動國王的問題。

-攻擊不消耗能量:
*現在國王的攻擊不會再消耗能量，
減少了後期的攻擊次數。

-召集全部放在旗幟前面:
*現在玩家會依序認識召集全部、
召集旗幟、召集範圍和召集單位了。

-切換語言同時更新左上狀態資訊:
*現在更換語言時也會將左上的狀態資訊同步翻譯了。

-可調整召集半徑:
*新增了一個調整召集半徑的功能，
除了可以進行集中攻擊外，
也能將旗幟插在城鎮中心當作巡邏範圍。

----

notes.title: 【MiniMap Kingdom】Update # 5 : Early Access!!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206008/15b8567cf6cb2788ef729973164e57ea44689c0d.jpg

【MiniMap Kingdom】Update # 5

After three weeks of not sleeping,
I finally gave【MiniMap Kingdom】to Steam,
There is a 40% discount in the first week, hope you can enjoy it!
(つд⊂)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206008/cc24e2563d064def9fa59979baf89b96ac57f74f.jpg

Detail:

-Builder:
* Added construction workers and construction workshops responsible for automatic repair of buildings.

-Doctors:
* Added doctors and hospitals that will restore blood volume for the unit.

-Priest:
* Added priests and monasteries that consume knowledge in the city to gain divine power,
If it is an enemy priest, it will reduce the player's divine power when preaching.

-Resource point system:
* Added four types of terrain: wheat seedlings, saplings, deep and shallow water and sand pits,
Now when the farmers plant, the watermen draw the water and the miners mine,
It will take a while for resources to grow before they can be collected again.

-The camera moves freely:
*Now you can move the mouse to the free moving lens at the edge of the screen,
And the speed of movement will increase as the lens zooms in,
Added a Home button to return to the character.

-New difficulty system:
* Added simple, ordinary and difficult mode selection,
And a Steam achievement unlocked in hard mode.

-Fixed the problem of judging the location of the parcel when the coordinates are negative:
*Fixed a problem with position determination that may occur when the character explores x and y are negative.

-Reducing the number of enemy days:
*Now the enemy is more focused on the resources he has actually collected,
Not just because of the increase in days.

-Improve the initial village:
*The initial village now opened is a complete small village with a population of 36.

-Optimization of image assets:
* Organized outdated resources of store pages and collections,
A series of new screenshots have been added.

-Decrease the number of enemy buildings and increase the number of days:
*Now the enemy will no longer be over-built simply because of the number of days.

-Enemy attack frequency:
*Now the enemy will have a higher chance to regenerate the day between attacks.

-Enemies attack the horn:
* Added two horn sound effects for enemy attack and stop attack.

-Enemies give priority to building basic structures:
* Now the enemy is more focused on maintaining the balance of economic production,
Instead of building a large number of military buildings but no resources.

-Enemy Mining Group:
*The enemies entering the map are no longer just the army,
There will also be a small group of mining groups.

-Enemy spawn team:
* Enemy troops entering the map are no longer scattered on the edge of the map,
Instead, organize the team and enter the map.

-Map boundary optimization:
*The boundary of the map will now refer to the nearest player building distance more correctly,
To decide whether to generate inward or outward.

-Fixed player attack speed:
*Now the player's later attack speed will no longer increase with the level index.

-Building population balance:
*Now players and enemies have a more reasonable building and population ratio,
Reduced the situation of excessive population expansion.

-In-situ production unit after construction:
*Now the population vacated by the new building will be produced at the location of the new building,
Instead of running back to the old town to produce.

-The scope of unit search resources gradually increases:
* Now the AI ​​of production units tends to observe the resources near them first,
Then gradually look for available resource points outward.

-Resource storage system:
*Now units and buildings will have their storage variability based on actual production.

-Increase the range of workers' enemies:
*Workers who need to go out to work now have twice the enemy search range,
Increase their ability to survive in the wild.

-The doctor automatically returns blood:
* Added a special ability for doctors to treat themselves.

-Call doctors:
*Now you can take the initiative to summon doctors to your side.


細節:

-建築工:
*新增了負責自動修理建築的建築工和建築工坊。

-醫生:
*新增了會替單位恢復血量的醫生和醫院。

-教士:
*新增了在城市中消耗知識來獲得神力的教士與修道院，
如果是敵人的教士，傳教時則會減少玩家的神力。

-資源點系統:
*加入了小麥苗、樹苗、深淺水和沙坑四種地形，
現在當農夫種植、打水工打水和礦工挖礦後，
資源會需要一段時間成長才能再次採集。

-相機自由移動:
*現在可以把滑鼠移動到螢幕邊緣來自由的移動鏡頭了，
並且移動的速度也會隨鏡頭放大而增加，
新增了一個Home鍵來回到角色身邊。

-新增難度系統:
*新增了簡單、普通和困難的模式選擇，
以及一個在困難模式下解鎖的Steam成就。

-修正座標為負時判定地塊位置問題:
*修正了一個當角色探索到x,y值為負後可能出現的位置判定問題。

-減少敵人天數資源:
*現在敵人更著重於自己實際採集的資源，
而不只是單純的因為天數而增加了。

-完善初始村莊:
*現在開場的初始村莊是一個可容納36人口的完整小村落了。

-圖像資產優化:
*整理了商店頁面和收藏庫的過時資源，
新增了一系列的新截圖。

-減少敵人建築數天數遞增:
*現在敵人不會再單純的因為天數而過度建設了。

-敵人進攻頻率:
*現在敵人在進攻之間會有更高的機率喘息重整一天。

-敵人進攻號角:
*新增了敵人進攻和停止進攻的兩種號角音效。

-敵人更優先建造基本建築:
*現在敵人更側重於維持經濟生產的平衡，
而不是建造大量的軍事建築卻沒有資源了。

-敵人採集團:
*現在進入地圖的敵人不再只有軍隊，
也會出現一小隊的採集團。

-敵人生成隊伍:
*現在進入地圖的敵方部隊不再分散於地圖的邊緣，
而是組織隊伍後再進入地圖。

-地圖邊界優化:
*現在地圖的邊界會更正確的參考最近的玩家建築距離，
來決定是否要向內或向外生成。

-修正玩家攻擊速度:
*現在玩家後期的攻擊速度不會再隨著等級指數增加了。

-建築人口數平衡:
*現在玩家與敵人的建築和人口比例更加的合理了，
減少了人口過度膨脹的情況。

-建造建築後原地生產單位:
*現在新建築所空出的人口將會生產在新建築的位置，
而不是大老遠跑回舊市鎮去生產了。

-單位搜尋資源範圍逐漸增加:
*現在生產單位的AI傾向於先觀察自己附近的資源，
然後再逐漸向外尋找可用的資源點。

-資源儲藏系統:
*現在單位和建築會依照實際產量有他的儲藏變率了。

-增加工人索敵範圍:
*現在需要外出工作的工人有了兩倍的索敵範圍，
增加他們在野外的生存能力。

-醫生自動回血:
*給醫生添加了一個治療自己的特殊能力。

-召集醫生:
*現在可以主動召集醫生到身旁了。

----

If you want to join the new test,  choose the public beta version,
I will continue to maintain the development progress.

notes.title: 【MiniMap Kingdom】Update # 4
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206008/e9fd772d44e96952d90177ac85e130e45f1877d4.jpg

【MiniMap Kingdom】Update # 4

Detail:

-Enemy city activation:
* Now the enemy cities will be more dynamic to produce units according to economic conditions,
And workers will have longer time to collect in their own town.

-Merchants and shops:
* Added a new unit building for merchants that can make up for gold mines in the later period.

-Initialize the small village:
*A small village with roads and plans will be generated at the beginning.

-The main menu background world:
*Now the auto-generated village will also run under the main menu.

-New achievements:
* Added 10 Steam achievements about rank and kingdom size.

-Unit collection range:
*Now the unit has a wider collection range and more accurate AI judgment.

-Construction conditions prompt to create roads with divine power:
*Now you will be prompted to build roads with tools.

-Fixed the location of the outermost parcel of reading:
*Fixed a new plot that did not expand the map boundary information at the same time,
A small problem that caused black plots in the outermost layer of the map reading.

-Producers no longer require food:
*Even if the unit is produced, it will actually consume resources,
But farmers, as producers of food, will no longer mandate food reserves,
Increased stability during economic imbalances.

-Slightly lower the mining volume:
*0.5 changed to 0.4.

-The lower scroll bar is strengthened:
*The scroll bar for switching more units below the smaller one has become more eye-catching,
After that, it will be made into a button for easier switching.

-Initial color optimization:
*The preset player color is now light orange.

-Interface translation optimization:
*Multiple language selections for the remaining switching fields and setting field interface are completed,
Removed some excessive Chinese-English mixed parts.

-Opening village enhancement:
* Increased to two houses and a pool with their own wells.

-AI optimization for enemy buildings:
*Now the enemy will generate buildings based on the player's kingdom development status.

-Adjust knight fighting power:
*Now the knight has more acceptable attack power and health.

-Camera preset size optimization:
* Now you can see further.


細節:

-敵人城市活化:
*現在敵人的城市會更有活力的依照經濟情況生產單位，
並且工人會有更長的時間待在自己的城鎮中進行採集。

-商人和商店:
*新增了後期可以補足金礦需求的商人新單位建築。

-初始化小村莊:
*現在開場時會生成一個附帶道路和規劃的小小村莊了。

-主選單背景世界:
*現在主選單下面也會跑這個自動生成的小村莊。

-新成就:
*新增了10個關於等級和王國大小的Steam成就。

-單位蒐集範圍:
*現在單位有了更廣的蒐集範圍和更精確的AI判定。

-建築條件提示用神力創造道路:
*現在也會提示能通過工具來鋪路建設了。

-修正讀檔最外層地塊生成位置:
*修正了一個新增地塊時沒有同時擴張地圖邊界資訊，
導致讀檔地圖的最外層產生黑色地塊的小問題。

-生產農夫不再強制要求食物:
*即便生產單位時還是會實際的消耗資源，
但農夫作為食物的生產者將不再強制要求食物儲備，
增加了經濟失衡時的穩定性。

-略為降低挖掘音量:
*0.5改為0.4。

-下方滾動條加強:
*將過小的下方切換更多單位滾動條變得更醒目了，
之後會做成更方便切換的按鈕。

-初始顏色優化:
*現在預設的玩家顏色是淡橙色。

-介面翻譯優化:
*完成了剩下的切換欄位、設定欄位介面的多語言選擇，
移除了一些過度中英混雜的部分。

-開場村莊加強:
*增加為兩個房屋和附帶各自的水井水池。

-敵人建築AI優化:
*現在敵人會參考玩家的王國發展狀態來生成建築了。

-調整騎士戰鬥力:
*現在騎士有了比較可接受的攻擊力和血量。

-相機預設大小優化:
*現在可以看得更遠了。

If you want to join the new test, you can choose the public beta version,
I will continue to maintain the development progress.

notes.title: 【MiniMap Kingdom】Update # 3
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206008/ae5c98f8cb53c3ac6bc52fae728721aee3868061.jpg

【MiniMap Kingdom】Update # 3

Detail:

-99% translation:
* Completed almost all translation systems,
Now you can play in 99% English or Chinese (including traditional and simplified) environment,
It also makes it easier for future development to add other languages.

-Knights and castles:
* Added fast moving knight and arrow rain castle.

-Tips for building conditions:
* Now the building will clearly indicate the actual resources needed,
Fixed an issue that fixed displaying divine power consumption,
Added Chinese translation to resources.

-Resource balance:
*Improve the amount of food collected by workers and reduce the irrigation water consumption of farmers,
This will make the earlier period better.

-The probability of enemy attacks increases with the number of days:
*Now there will be a more compact attack frequency later.

-Tips to fight back enemies:
* There is now a prompt to repel the enemy,
And increase the basic energy obtained by repeling the enemy.

-Fixed the prompt to restart the game:
* Fixed an issue when restarting the game
Minor issue where the switch text of the convening unit needs to be updated manually.

-"Scope" does not collide:
*Now collision events will not occur between the two trigger ranges,
This obviously optimizes the unit performance in the later stage.

-Calling knights:
*Knights can now be summoned separately.

-Enemy Knight:
* Enemy knights will now spawn.

-Terrain affects the unit moving speed ratio:
* Now the terrain is no longer just a fixed acceleration value,
Instead, the multiplier is provided based on the unit’s base speed,
For example, knights will also be slowed by terrain in the river.

-Improve the basic summon power of advanced units:
*Now summoning advanced military units requires more magic power.

-Reduce the number of opening enemies:
* Reduced the number of enemies with too many openings,
Increased the early fault tolerance rate.

-Teaching fifth page:
* Added teaching about language selection at the beginning.

-Enemy building AI:
*Now the enemy will advance with time,
Try to pave the way around the player and the player’s construction,
And build various buildings,
Fixed the problem of the generation range of enemies too close,
The initial map size has been tripled.

-The enemy population consumes resources:
* Various units and buildings of the enemy will consume the enemy resources with the same consumption as the player.

-Slow down when moving on buildings:
*Now when the unit tries to move on the building, it will only have a relatively slow movement speed,
Therefore, in urban planning, it is more necessary to leave roads between buildings to facilitate movement.

-Only display the UI within the player range at close range:
*It will no longer waste performance to display the status of units outside the lens.

-Optimized unit AI:
*Fixed an issue where a unit would move more towards the right of the map,
And optimized the number and scope of their goal search.

-The school needs additional wood:
*Improved school wood consumption that is too low.

-Population and divine power are displayed together:
* Optimized the bilingual population and the magical power gained by the population every hour,
And it will be clearly displayed in the magic bar below.

-Construction production units do not mandate secondary resources:
*Even if the unit still consumes the resources needed for production,
But basic units such as workers, watermen and farmers,
It is no longer mandatory for them to be responsible for the production resources or the secondary resources required.

-Display red when the resource is negative:
*Now when the resources are insufficient, it will be reminded with bright colors.

-Summon basic production units without consuming resources:
*No longer consumes additional resources in addition to divine power when summoning basic units.


細節:

-99%翻譯:
*完成了幾乎全部的翻譯系統，
現在可以在99%英文或中文(包括繁體和簡體)的環境下遊玩了，
也讓之後的開發可以更方便的新增其他語言新增。

-騎士和城堡:
*新增了快速移動的騎士和箭雨效果的城堡。

-建築條件提示:
*現在建築時會清楚的提示實際需要的資源了，
修正了固定顯示神力消耗量的問題，
給資源加上了中文翻譯。

-資源平衡:
*提高了工人採集的食物量並降低了農夫的灌溉耗水，
這會讓前期好過一些。

-敵人攻擊機率隨天數上升:
*現在後期會有更緊湊的攻擊頻率。

-擊退敵人提示:
*現在新增了擊退敵人的提示，
並且增加了擊退敵人獲得的基礎能量。

-修正重開遊戲召集中提示:
*修正了一個重開遊戲時，
需要手動更新召集單位開關文字的小問題。

-「範圍」不碰撞:
*現在兩個觸發範圍將不會發生碰撞事件，
這明顯的優化了後期的單位效能。

-召集騎士:
*現在可以單獨召集騎士了。

-敵人騎士:
*現在也會生成敵人騎士了。

-地形影響單位移動速度倍率:
*現在地形不再只是給一個固定的加速值，
而是依照該單位的基礎速度來提供倍率，
譬如騎士在河裡也會受到地形減速。

-提高高級單位基礎召喚神力:
*現在召喚高級的軍事單位需要更多的神力了。

-減少開場敵人數量:
*減少了開場過多的敵人數量，
增加了前期的容錯率。

-教學第五頁:
*新增了語言選擇相關的教學放在最開始。

-敵人建築AI:
*現在敵人會隨著時間推進，
嘗試在玩家和玩家建設的外圍鋪路，
並建造各種建築，
修正了敵人過近的生成範圍問題，
將初始地圖大小增加了兩倍。

-敵人人口消耗資源:
*現在敵人的各種單位與建築會跟玩家用同樣的消耗量來消耗敵人資源了。

-在建築上移動時減速:
*現在當單位嘗試在建築上移動時會只剩相對緩慢的移動速度，
所以城市規劃上更需要於建築間留下道路來方便移動了。

-近距離時僅顯示在玩家範圍內的UI:
*現在不會再浪費效能於顯示鏡頭外的單位狀態了。

-優化單位AI:
*修正了一個單位會更趨向地圖右方移動的問題，
並優化了他們尋找目標的次數和範圍。

-學校需求額外木材:
*提高了過低的學校木材消耗量。

-人口和神力一起顯示:
*優化了雙語的人口和人口每小時獲得的神力，
並會在下方的神力條一起清楚的顯示了。

-建築生產單位不強制要求次要資源:
*即便單位還是會消耗生產所需的資源，
但基礎單位如工人、打水工和農夫，
不再強制要求他們本身負責生產的資源或需求的次要資源了。

-資源為負時顯示紅色:
*現在當資源不足時會用鮮明的顏色提示了。

-召喚基礎生產單位不消耗資源:
*現在召喚基本單位時除了神力外不會再消耗額外的資源了。

Players need to summon units to get the initial resources for construction.

* Attempted to fix the problem of single digits being eaten after a unit of 100 people.

* Deleted some unnecessary prompts,
And did the UI layout to make the teaching easier to continue.

*Improved the low-consumption wood and other resources.

*Now the workers are more resistant,
The archer will not shoot two arrows so quickly in a second.

*Added the fourth page of teaching.

notes.title: 【MiniMap Kingdom】Update #1
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206008/465e72165b0e8230d033f5da665f702b5ccfbb2c.jpg

【MiniMap Kingdom】Update #1

Detail:

-Unit collection AI:
*Now the unit has a new collection system,
They will more actively look for the corresponding resources nearby,
For example, mining unions look for minerals, water unions look for water sources,
In detail, every time the unit moves, you will get map information in the range of 6*6,
And try to find a plot that matches your needs and move to the target,
This obviously reduces some strange situations,
For example, a large number of units are stuck in the moat,
And greatly increase the efficiency and rationality of resource collection.

-Field of view zoom optimization:
*The magnification of each zoom is now increased by 25 times,
In addition to the feeling of a small map kingdom,
It will automatically hide all the details UI when zooming in,
It should also slightly alleviate the problem of unit jitter.

-UI font optimization:
*Some fonts in the scene that are easily covered have obvious borders,
And the state of the unit has a clearer size.

-Optimized resource production translation:
*A clearer bilingual production system prompt will now be displayed at the opening.

-Building distance 0.84:
* Fixed an issue where buildings could be stacked together when the closest building distance is 0.7.

-miner uppercase
*It is now Miner.

-Blood bar display range 15 changed to 20:
Now zooming the lens to 20 will also show blood bars.

-Reduce the frequency of enemy attacks:
Adjusted the chance of stopping the attack for one day from 10% to 25%.

-Actual tips for getting energy:
Now the population and energy prompt on the left is no longer just a prompt for the population value,
It is the divine power actually acquired every hour.

-The following operation buttons are typeset:
Now it has moved 50 units neatly to the left.

-Changed the delay and number of shots of the arrow tower:
Changed from the original 1 arrow every 1 second to 3 to 5 arrows every 2 seconds.

-Increase the frequency of automatic cleaning of the upper left log:
*Change from 5000 words to 1000 words to avoid overflowing blanks.

-Tips on the upper left UI Chinese:
Added some more intimate translation and typesetting.

-Reduce unit resource output:
*As the unit will now actively seek out the resources it needs,
Workers’ harvested farmland changed from 100 to 50,
Lumberjacks cut trees from 100 to 50.

-Improve gold mining rate:
Before the businessman joins the game,
The mining rate was changed from 10% to 25%.


細節:

-單位採集AI:
*現在單位有了新的採集系統，
他們會更積極的尋找附近的相應資源，
譬如礦工會尋找礦物、打水工會去尋找水源、
細節上，每次單位移動都會獲得6*6範圍內的地圖資訊，
並且嘗試找到和自己需求相符的地塊往目標地移動，
這明顯減少了一些奇怪的情況，
譬如大量單位卡在護城河之類的，
並且大幅增加了資源採集的效率與合理性。

-視野縮放優化:
*現在每次縮放的倍率增加了25倍，
除了比較有小地圖王國的感覺外，
放大時會自動隱藏所有細節UI，
應該也能稍微緩解單位抖動的問題。

-UI字體優化:
*現在場景中一些容易被遮住的字體有了明顯的邊框，
並且單位的狀態有了更清晰的大小。

-優化資源生產翻譯:
*現在開場時會顯示更清楚的雙語生產系統提示了。

-建築距離0.84:
*修正了一個最近建築距離為0.7時可以把建築疊在一起的問題。

-miner大寫
*現在是Miner了。

-血條顯示範圍15改為20:
現在鏡頭放大到20也會顯示血條了。

-降低敵人攻擊頻率:
停止攻擊一天的機率從10%調整為25%。

-獲得能量實際提示:
現在左側的人口與能量提示不再只是提示人口值，
而是每小時實際獲得的神力。

-下方操作按鈕排版:
現在向左整齊移動了50單位。

-更改箭塔射擊延遲和射擊數量:
從原本的每1秒1箭改為每2秒3~5箭。

-提高左上日誌自動清理頻率:
*從5000字改為1000字，避免溢出空白問題。

-左上UI中文提示:
新增了一些比較有親切感的翻譯排版。

-減少單位資源產量:
*由於單位現在會積極地尋找自己需要的資源了，
工人收割農田從100改為50，
伐木工砍樹從100改為50。

-提高金礦挖掘率:
在商人加入遊戲前，
挖掘率從10%改為25%。
